decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extensions by reason of their scale, design and appearance would be out of character with and unsympathetic to the character of the existing house, and the pattern of development in the area. The proposal would thereby result in harm to the Cranford Village Conservation Area contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The applicant has failed to provide a method statement detailing measures to be taken to ensure that the protected Horse Chestnut Tree (TPO 32) is not harmed during or after the construction of the proposed extension. Given the proximity of the proposed extension to the tree, it appears likely that the proposed building works would harm the health of the tree and diminish its amenity value, so harming the appearance of the Cranford Village Conservation Area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-N.2.8 (Tree Preservation Orders) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas).
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension conversion of existing garage into habitable room and erection of new garage in front of house.
